svg.title: Type-checking benchmark: wall time and peak memory
svg.desc: Default settings on 16 vCPUs. Depot CI depot-ubuntu-24.04-16 (16 vCPU, 63 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 9R45 96-Core Processor) median of 10 interleaved runs (3 for tsgo). Bars scaled within each project; lower is better. Values are wall-clock seconds and peak resident memory. Failed or unavailable measurements are marked n/a and have no bar. Measured 2026-10-11 15:44 UTC, tsrs commit e4abda9b23e8.
